enriched_activities.activity: Sleeping in bed after a late finish, catching up on rest in a quiet room
enriched_activities.desc: Lie in bed. Close eyes. Breathe slowly. Turn to right side. Pull blanket up. Adjust pillow. Turn to left side. Stretch legs. Lie on back. Put arm under pillow. Turn to right side again. Pull blanket down. Turn to left side. Bend knees. Lie still. Breathe deeply. Open eyes briefly. Close eyes. Turn to back. Remain still.

enriched_activities.activity: Waking up slowly, stretching, and checking phone reminders and the day's written to-do list
enriched_activities.desc: Open eyes. Stretch arms. Sit up. Swing legs over edge. Stand. Reach for phone. Press power button. Look at screen. Tap reminders app. Put phone down. Pick up to-do list. Read list.

enriched_activities.activity: Showering, washing face, brushing teeth and getting dressed
enriched_activities.desc: Walk to bathroom. Turn on light. Turn on shower. Adjust temperature. Step in. Wet body. Apply soap. Rinse. Apply shampoo. Rinse hair. Turn off shower. Step out. Dry with towel. Turn on tap. Wash face with cleanser. Rinse. Dry face. Brush teeth. Rinse mouth. Turn off tap.

enriched_activities.activity: Preparing and eating a flexitarian breakfast of oats, fruit and toast while brewing a pot of tea
enriched_activities.desc: Walk to kitchen. Turn on light. Open fridge. Take out milk and fruit. Open cupboard. Take out oats, bread, bowl, plate. Pour oats into bowl. Add milk and fruit. Put bread in toaster. Press lever. Take out toast. Put on plate. Fill kettle. Boil water. Pour into teapot. Add tea leaves. Steep. Pour tea into cup. Sit. Eat.

enriched_activities.activity: Washing dishes, wiping the counters and tidying shared kitchen surfaces
enriched_activities.desc: Fill sink with water. Add dish soap. Pick up sponge. Scrub dishes. Rinse dishes. Place dishes on drying rack. Pick up towel. Dry dishes. Put dishes in cupboard. Spray counter with cleaner. Wipe counter with cloth. Rinse cloth. Wring cloth. Wipe counter again. Sweep floor with broom. Pick up dustpan. Sweep debris into dustpan. Empty dustpan into bin.

enriched_activities.activity: Sitting at the desk, reviewing the weekly budget, tallying cash spending and writing a shopping list
enriched_activities.desc: Walk to bedroom. Sit at desk. Open drawer. Take out budget book. Open budget book. Take out pen. Write down expenses. Open phone. Tap banking app. Check account balance. Write down balance. Add up cash spending. Write total. Take out notebook. Write shopping list. Close budget book. Put away pen. Close drawer.

enriched_activities.activity: Sorting, washing and drying laundry and folding clean clothes
enriched_activities.desc: Walk to bathroom. Open hamper. Sort clothes into piles. Pick up dark pile. Put in washing machine. Add detergent. Close door. Set cycle. Press start. Wait for cycle to finish. Open door. Take out clothes. Put in dryer. Set dryer. Press start. Wait for dryer. Open door. Take out clothes. Fold clothes. Put folded clothes in basket.

enriched_activities.activity: Texting and video calling family in China, looking at the photo of the family dog
enriched_activities.desc: Sit on bed. Pick up phone. Press power button. Swipe to unlock. Tap messaging app. Type message. Tap send. Tap video call app. Dial number. Wait for answer. Speak into phone. Listen. Wave at screen. End call. Pick up photo frame. Look at photo. Put photo frame down. Pick up phone again. Type another message. Tap send.

enriched_activities.activity: Cooking a flexitarian lunch of rice, vegetables and tofu, eating it, then washing up
enriched_activities.desc: Walk to kitchen. Wash rice. Put rice in rice cooker with water and turn on. Wash vegetables. Chop vegetables. Cut tofu. Heat pan. Add oil. Stir-fry vegetables and tofu. Turn off heat. Scoop rice into bowl. Put vegetables and tofu on plate. Sit. Eat with chopsticks. Clear table. Wash dishes. Dry dishes. Put away dishes.

enriched_activities.activity: Travelling by train and bus from Clayton to the animal shelter
enriched_activities.desc: Walk to train station. Tap Opal card on reader. Walk to platform. Wait for train. Board train. Find seat. Sit down. Arrive at station. Stand up. Walk to exit. Tap Opal card. Walk to bus stop. Wait for bus. Board bus. Tap Opal card. Sit down. Arrive at shelter. Stand up. Walk to exit. Tap Opal card. Walk to shelter entrance.

enriched_activities.activity: Volunteering at the animal shelter, feeding and socialising the animals and cleaning their pens
enriched_activities.desc: Enter shelter. Sign in. Put on apron. Fill food bowls. Place bowls in pens. Open pen. Pet dog. Brush cat. Spray pen with hose. Scrub floor. Rinse. Use squeegee. Refill water bowls. Play with puppy. Clean litter box. Sweep floor. Put away supplies. Remove apron. Sign out.

enriched_activities.activity: Travelling home by bus and train
enriched_activities.desc: Walk to bus stop. Wait for bus. Board bus. Tap card. Sit down. Arrive at station. Stand up. Walk to exit. Tap card. Walk to train platform. Wait for train. Board train. Find seat. Sit down. Arrive at Clayton. Stand up. Walk to exit. Tap card. Walk home.

enriched_activities.activity: Washing hands and changing into comfortable home clothes
enriched_activities.desc: Walk to bathroom. Turn on tap. Wet hands. Apply soap. Rub hands together. Rinse hands. Turn off tap. Dry hands with towel. Walk to bedroom. Take off work clothes. Put on t-shirt. Put on sweatpants.

enriched_activities.activity: Cooking and eating a simple flexitarian dinner with tea instead of alcohol
enriched_activities.desc: Walk to kitchen. Open fridge. Take out vegetables. Take out tofu. Close fridge. Wash vegetables. Chop vegetables. Cut tofu. Heat pan. Add oil. Stir-fry vegetables and tofu. Turn off heat. Scoop rice into bowl. Put stir-fry on plate. Sit at table. Eat with chopsticks. Drink tea. Clear table.

enriched_activities.activity: Washing up and packing a container of food for the next rostered shift
enriched_activities.desc: Clear table. Scrape plates into bin. Stack dishes. Fill sink with water. Add soap. Wash dishes. Rinse dishes. Place on drying rack. Dry dishes. Put away dishes. Take out food container. Open container. Spoon food into container. Close container. Put container in fridge. Wipe counter.

enriched_activities.activity: Reading course materials and drafting assignment notes on the computer at the desk
enriched_activities.desc: Walk to bedroom. Sit at desk. Turn on desk lamp. Open laptop. Press power button. Wait for startup. Open course materials. Read document. Open word processor. Type notes. Highlight text. Copy and paste. Save document. Close laptop.

enriched_activities.activity: Taking an evening shower and getting ready for bed
enriched_activities.desc: Walk to bathroom. Turn on light. Turn on shower. Adjust temperature. Step in. Wet body. Apply soap. Rinse. Apply shampoo. Rinse hair. Turn off shower. Step out. Dry with towel. Put on pajamas. Brush teeth. Rinse mouth. Turn off light. Walk to bedroom.

enriched_activities.activity: Writing in a notebook, updating the calendar and setting reminders for the week's shifts
enriched_activities.desc: Sit at desk. Open notebook. Pick up pen. Write notes. Open phone. Tap calendar app. Add events. Set reminders. Tap reminders app. Add shifts. Put phone down. Close notebook. Put pen away.

enriched_activities.activity: Boiling the kettle and making a cup of tea
enriched_activities.desc: Walk to kitchen. Fill kettle with water. Turn on kettle. Wait for water to boil. Pour water into cup. Add tea bag. Steep tea. Remove tea bag. Add milk. Stir tea. Pick up cup. Walk to bedroom.

enriched_activities.activity: Sipping tea under the lamp, dimming the light and winding down quietly
enriched_activities.desc: Sit on bed. Pick up cup. Sip tea. Put cup down. Turn on desk lamp. Adjust lamp brightness. Dim lamp. Pick up cup. Sip tea. Put cup down. Pick up book. Read. Put book down. Turn off lamp. Lie down. Pull blanket up.

enriched_activities.activity: Sleeping
enriched_activities.desc: Lie in bed. Close eyes. Breathe slowly. Turn to right side. Pull blanket up. Adjust pillow. Turn to left side. Stretch legs. Lie on back. Put arm under pillow. Turn to right side again. Pull blanket down. Turn to left side. Bend knees. Lie still. Breathe deeply. Open eyes briefly. Close eyes. Turn to back. Remain still.
